first_comment: Steady is an app for saying the hard thing out loud before the real conversation: https://steadyyy.com
caption:
“You need to be more proactive” is feedback nobody can act on.

They nod. They leave. Nothing changes, because they don’t know which moment you meant.

Pick one real example from the last two weeks. Say what happened, then say what you needed.

What is the vaguest feedback you were ever given?

#newmanager #leadership #management

slides.headline: They can’t act on a <u>word</u>.
slides.sub: Proactive how? When? They leave the room and change nothing.

slides.label: Say this
slides.quote: “When the client went quiet, I needed you to call them by Wednesday.”

slides.headline: Name the moment, not the <u>trait</u>.
slides.sub: One real example is worth more than any adjective.

slides.headline: Say it out loud before you say it for real.
slides.sub: Steady lets you practice the hard conversation first.
